title: fix(metadata-protocol): title a record-share search hit by its recipient, not the raw recipient id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #35307
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在 ⌘K 面板和全局搜索里搜到一条记录共享时，标题从一串用户编号变成被共享人的名字；看不到该用户的人仍看到编号。
- 跟进全局搜索把关联字段标题显示成目标记录名的那次修复，替搜索用户解决共享记录标题看不懂的问题。
- 出错时最多是搜索标题又显示回编号，或目录读取故障时整次搜索报错（与关联字段一致）；直接回退本次改动即可撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`sys_record_share` is titled by `recipient_id`, a text column whose principal kind `recipient_type` names. `searchAll` followed only a reference-typed title pointer (`referenceTargetOf`), so every record-share hit in the palette read as a raw user id.

`searchAll` now recognises a title pointer that is a recipient id by the declaration the console's recipient face already reads: a `text` field with `widget: 'recipient-picker'` and `recipient_type` in its `dependsOn` (no object-name special case; another object carrying the declaration is titled the same way). The hit is titled by the directory record its row's kind names, mirroring the console's `RECIPIENT_RECORD_KINDS` table:

| `recipient_type` | directory read | title |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `user` | `sys_user` by id | its ADR-0079 title (`name`) |
| `unit_and_subordinates` (and `business_unit`) | `sys_business_unit` by id | `name` |
| `team` (not offered on `sys_record_share`) | `sys_team` by id | `name` |
| `group` | none: no directory object exists anywhere | stored id kept (the console keeps it too) |
| `position` | none: a registry kind, read by the console through the metadata store, not as the searcher | stored value kept |

Each directory is read once per swept object (`id $in`), through the existing `readReferenceTitles`, so the read is the searcher's and every gate and disposition of the #34175 reference follow applies unchanged: exposure must serve `get`, disabled-package targets are not read, `canReadObject` is asked first, a typed `PERMISSION_DENIED` / row scope / field-level security leaves the bare id, an unprovisioned table titles nothing, and any other read failure propagates (the 2026-08-29 search ruling: a read that could not run is never answered as no match). The hit wire shape does not move; `record` still carries the stored id.

Files: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts`, new `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.search-title-recipient-35307.test.ts`, `.changeset/35307-search-recipient-title.md`. No existing test was changed.

Read first: `protocol-record-reads.ts` `recipientKindFieldOf` (the declaration gate) and `readRecipientTitles` (grouping ids by directory), then the `renderTitle` call in the sweep loop.

## Tests

New file `protocol.search-title-recipient-35307.test.ts` (12 cases): user and business-unit recipients titled by name while group and position keep the stored value; one read per directory as the searcher (`id`+`name` only); wire shape unchanged; object-level refusal (never read), refusal thrown by the read, row scope and FLS each keep the bare id; `recipient_type` hidden from the searcher pays no read; unprovisioned table keeps the hit; a failing directory read fails the search with its own `code`/`status`; another object with the declaration is titled the same; without the widget or without `dependsOn` nothing changes; a reference-typed `nameField` still follows its target.

## Acceptance notes

- The kind-to-directory table is a second copy of the console's `RECIPIENT_RECORD_KINDS` (objectui `@object-ui/fields`); the server cannot import the UI package. Lifting it into a spec contract both sides read is a spec change outside this card.
- A failing (non-refusal) directory read fails the whole search, as a failing reference title read already does; it is not turned into a bare-id title, which the read-invention gate and the search ruling both forbid.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.search-title-recipient-35307.test.ts`, expected 12 passed.

Readings at head e8b22f7f (merge base 316f7571, origin/main unchanged at PR open):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exit 0; `vitest run`: 363 files passed, 9 skipped; 23336 tests passed, 45 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- New file plus the two sibling title suites (`search-title-lookup`, `search-title-namefield`): 3 files, 32 tests passed.

</details>
